title: 第19章 小松鼠第20章 认主
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
这时只听锵——的一声，剑锋与野猪相撞的瞬间，一道凌厉的剑芒炸开，轰然巨响中，狂暴的冲击波横扫四周，数丈内的树木瞬间被震得粉碎，木屑纷飞。
宁知初只觉一股巨力袭来，整个人被震得向后倒飞，眼看就要撞上身后的大树——她却不慌不忙，半空中一个灵巧的旋身，双脚在树干上轻轻一踏，借力翻身，稳稳落地，衣袂翻飞间，连发丝都没乱半分。
而那头野猪妖兽就没这么潇洒了，它被震退得更远，四蹄在地上犁出几道深深的沟壑才勉强停下。
仔细一看，它身上已经多了几道剑气划出的血痕，可头顶那只独角却依旧完好无损，连个划痕都没有。
宁知初挑了挑眉：嚯，这角还挺硬啊！
她兴致更浓，手腕一翻，剑锋寒光一闪，正要再战——
谁知那野猪妖兽抬头看了她一眼，突然浑身一抖，二话不说，扭头就跑！
四蹄狂奔，尘土飞扬，眨眼间就蹿进林子深处，连头都不敢回。
宁知初愣在原地，剑还举在半空，眨了眨眼：……这就跑了？她有些遗憾的说道，这才过了一招啊！
摇摇头，收剑入鞘，忍不住嘀咕道：这妖兽怎么这么怂呀？说好的凶悍呢？
宁知初正感叹着这妖兽真怂，忽然头顶一声响。
她轻巧地侧身一闪，一颗松果擦着发丝滚落在地。
她警惕地放出神识往树上一探，顿时笑出了声：
抬头望去，只见粗壮的树干上蹲着只圆滚滚的小家伙——棕色的皮毛油光水滑，雪白的肚皮像个蓬松的小毛球，最逗的是那双黑豆似的眼睛，正滴溜溜地转着。
仔细一感应，嚯，居然也是只二阶妖兽！
这小松鼠正费劲儿地堵在一个大树洞前，两只小爪子拼命往后扒拉着什么。
宁知初定睛一看，好家伙，树洞里堆满了各色灵果，都快溢出来了。
小家伙手忙脚乱的样子正是在堵着洞口，不让东西掉下来，应该是刚才打斗不小心撞到了小松鼠的窝。
——一颗碧绿如玉的灵果从小松鼠爪缝里露了出来。
宁知初眼疾手快，伸手一捞就接住了。

小松鼠顿时急得直跺脚，圆眼睛瞪得更大了，慌慌张张往后一缩。
这一缩可坏了事，树洞里哗啦啦又滚下来好几颗灵果。
宁知初双手并用，接了个满满当当。
仔细一看，好家伙，全是二阶三阶的灵果，这要是拿去集市上，也能换上不少灵石呢！
于是她随手就将这些灵果收了起来，随后她抬头看着急得团团转的小松鼠，眨了眨眼试探道：小松鼠，你这些果子...还有不要的吗？不要的尽管扔下来，我帮你接着啊！
说着还特意张开双手，摆出个随时准备接果子的架势。
那小松鼠闻言一愣，随即气鼓鼓地了一声，抱着几颗果子往树洞里退了退，大尾巴一甩一甩的，可爱极了。
宁知初见了更觉可爱，便上前一步，小松鼠松鼠瞬间支棱起毛茸茸的小耳朵，两颗黑豆豆般的眼睛瞪得圆溜溜的，一眨不眨地盯着她看。
那眼神里三分控诉七分委屈。
看着松鼠气鼓鼓的模样，宁知初眼底漾开笑意，随手从储物袋中取出一颗莹润如玉的聚气丹。
content_en:
At this moment, there was only a clang sound. The moment the sword edge collided with the wild boar, a sharp sword light exploded. With a loud bang, a violent shock wave swept across the surroundings. The trees within a few feet were instantly shattered and sawdust flew.
Ning Zhichu only felt a huge force coming, and her whole body was shaken backwards. She was about to hit the big tree behind her - but she didn't panic. She made a dexterous spin in mid-air, stepped lightly on the tree trunk with her feet, used the force to turn over, and landed firmly on the ground. Her clothes were flying, and even her hair was not messed up.
The wild boar monster was not so cool. It was pushed back even further, and its four hooves plowed several deep ravines on the ground before it reluctantly stopped.
If you look closely, you can see that there are a few bloody marks on its body caused by the sword energy, but the horn on the top of its head is still intact, without even a scratch.
Ning Zhichu raised his eyebrows: Oh, this horn is quite hard!
She became more interested, flipped her wrist, and the cold light of the sword flashed, and she was about to fight again——
Unexpectedly, the wild boar monster looked up at her, suddenly trembled, turned around and ran away without saying a word!
Four hooves were running wildly, dust was flying, and he jumped deep into the forest in the blink of an eye, not even daring to look back.
Ning Zhichu was stunned on the spot, with his sword still raised in the air, and blinked: ...Running away now? She said with some regret, this is just one move passed!
Shaking his head, sheathing his sword, he couldn't help but mutter: Why is this monster so cowardly? What about being fierce as promised?
Ning Zhichu was sighing that this monster was really cowardly, when suddenly there was a sound above his head.
She ducked sideways lightly, and a pine cone rolled to the ground, grazing her hair.
She cautiously used her consciousness to look into the tree, and immediately laughed out loud:
Looking up, I saw a chubby little guy squatting on a thick tree trunk - his brown fur was smooth and smooth, his snow-white belly was like a fluffy little fur ball, and the most amusing thing was his black bean-like eyes that were spinning around.
When I sensed it carefully, oh, it turned out to be a second-level monster too!
This little squirrel was struggling to block a big tree hole, its two little paws trying to pull something back.
Ning Zhichu took a closer look and saw that the hole in the tree was filled with all kinds of spiritual fruits, almost overflowing.
The little guy was busy blocking the hole to prevent things from falling. He must have accidentally bumped into the little squirrel's nest during the fight.
——A jade-green spiritual fruit emerged from the crack of the squirrel's paw.
Ning Zhichu had quick eyes and quick hands, so he reached out and caught it.
The little squirrel suddenly stamped its feet in anxiety, its round eyes widened, and it shrank back in panic.
This shrinking was bad, and several spiritual fruits rolled down from the tree hole.
Ning Zhichu used his hands together to catch the whole thing.
Take a closer look, good guys, they are all second- and third-level spiritual fruits. If you take these to the market, you can exchange them for a lot of spiritual stones!
So she put away these spiritual fruits casually, then she looked up at the anxious little squirrel, blinked and asked: Little squirrel, do you want any more of these fruits? If you don't want it, just throw it down and I'll pick it up for you!
As he spoke, he deliberately opened his hands, as if ready to receive the fruit at any time.
The little squirrel was stunned when he heard this, and then he let out an angry sound, and backed away into the tree hole with a few fruits in his arms. His big tail swung back and forth, it was so cute.
Ning Zhi found it even more cute when she first saw it, so she took a step forward. The little squirrel instantly raised its fluffy little ears, and its two round eyes like black beans stared at her unblinkingly.
The look in his eyes was one part accusation and one part wronged.
Seeing the squirrel's angry expression, Ning Zhichu's eyes widened with a smile, and he casually took out a jade-like Qi Gathering Pill from his storage bag.
